name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A line of small grey text credits an account, and the underlined handle opens a compact profile card on hover: portrait, handle, a short description and a join date.
use: A name or handle needs a glanceable profile without sending the reader to another page.
avoid: It opens on hover or focus only, so touch users may never see the card at all.
a11y: The panel has no dialog or tooltip role, the trigger has no focus ring, and its zoom and fade ignore reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One line of grey text on black reading 'Built and maintained by @origin_ui.', the handle underlined. Hovering it opens a dark rounded panel below with a circular portrait, the handle in white, a two-line bio and a small calendar line.
behaves: Hovering or focusing the underlined handle fades and zooms in the profile panel, and moving away fades it out. The portrait pops into the panel a moment after it opens.
customise: Wrap your trigger and panel as children; open and close delays, alignment, side offset and the optional arrow are props, while panel width and content are yours.
weight: light: One small panel that fetches a single portrait only when it opens.
demo: The sentence 'Built and maintained by @origin_ui.' and a profile of that handle with 'Joined December 2023'.
issues: Frames 3 to 5 show the panel with an empty gap where the avatar should be
The panel's dark fill barely separates from the black page
polishWhy: Compact profile preview with a clear layout; the dark panel and empty-avatar frames weaken it.
